rule: 先列 Methods 下全部标题，再按位置取前七个 Step 小节；禁用标题去重

steps.label: S1
steps.title: Step 1 – Development of the scope and definition of the Intervention Source Ontology
steps.input: dictionaries and the TIDieR reporting guidelines
steps.output: A definition and overall topic for the ontology

steps.label: S2
steps.title: Step 2 – Identifying key entities and developing the preliminary Intervention Source Ontology
steps.input: 100 published reports of behaviour change interventions
steps.output: An initial prototype version of the ontology

steps.label: S3
steps.title: Step 3 – Refining the ontology through literature annotation, discussion and revision
steps.output: the ontology structure, definitions and annotation guidance were revised accordingly

steps.label: S4
steps.title: Step 4 – Expert stakeholder review
steps.input: 123 members of an existing international panel
steps.output: the Intervention Source Ontology and annotation guidance were revised

steps.label: S5
steps.title: Step 5 – Inter-rater reliability of annotations using the Intervention Source Ontology
steps.output: Inter-rater reliability was assessed using Krippendorff’s Alpha

steps.label: S6
steps.title: Step 6 – Specifying relationships between Intervention Source Ontology entities
steps.output: relationships between ontology entities to formalise the knowledge present in the ontology

steps.label: S7
steps.title: Step 7 – Disseminating and maintaining the Intervention Source Ontology
